description: She flipped a long-held Republican seat in the Georgia House of Representatives and has fought to defend it ever since, even after Republican leaders redrew her district three times to try to stop her. In the legislature, she’s been Georgia’s leading science voice, standing up to Republican attacks on facts, public health, and reproductive freedom, and fighting to make Georgia a safer, healthier, and fairer place for every family.
